name: faerie
description: Relights the color frame by a small wandering light: the infrared strobe pair (lit minus unlit) is the subject's illumination response, which stands in for depth — a height field and its normals — so a light placed in the frame shades the subject with wrapped Lambert, Blinn-Phong, distance falloff, and a short shadow march, and draws itself as a glowing sprite orbiting its anchor. The anchor is config, so another probe's reading (a tracked head) can carry it.

channels.name: x
channels.description: The light's horizontal position this cycle, -1 (left) to 1 (right).

channels.name: y
channels.description: The light's vertical position this cycle, -1 (bottom) to 1 (top).

channels.name: response
channels.description: The mean illumination response (lit minus unlit infrared) over the frame.

channels.name: coverage
channels.description: The fraction of pixels whose response clears the floor — how much of the frame the light can shape.

anchorX.description: The orbit center, horizontal, -1 (left) to 1 (right) — bind a tracked centroid here.

height.description: How far in front of the subject the light floats, in frame-width units.

orbitRadius.description: The orbit radius about the anchor, in frame-width units.

orbitSpeed.description: The orbit rate, in radians per second.

radius.description: The falloff distance at which the light halves, in frame-width units.

ambient.description: The frame's own light kept everywhere, as a fraction of the color frame.

relief.description: The height-field amplitude a full illumination response rises to, in frame-width units.

floor.description: The response below which a pixel counts as background (unlit by the strobe, out of the light's reach).

gain.description: The multiplier that maps raw lit-minus-unlit luminance to a 0..1 response.

irScale.description: The infrared frame's scale relative to the color frame about their shared center, on top of the aspect-derived span (equal vertical fields of view at 1).

irOffsetX.description: The infrared frame's horizontal offset relative to the color frame, in color-frame widths.

irOffsetY.description: The infrared frame's vertical offset relative to the color frame, in color-frame heights.

spriteSize.description: The glowing sprite's radius, in frame-width units.
